verdict.rationale: 1Password's documented Watchtower feature tells users about breaches, weak passwords, duplicate (reused) items and other security problems with saved items, which covers the core of this story. The evidence is a single support-page sentence plus a release note on Watchtower flagging passkey-capable logins. missing for 10: explicit documentation of exposed/compromised-password detection (beyond the general "breaches"), detail on how and when warnings are delivered proactively, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the app warns me when a service I use is breached or a stored credential is weak, reused, or exposed

citations.quote: Watchtower tells you about breaches, weak passwords, duplicate items, and other security problems with the items you have saved in 1Password.
opening Watchtower in 1Password, which now flags all of your existing logins that could be updated with a passkey
